answer: Random-Permission Lottery. Each epoch, a beacon whose seed is derived from a fresh verifiable random function assigns every agent a region of the admission ridge; slots are filled only by agents whose assigned region matches, and assignments reshuffle unpredictably like a basalt cliff face eroding under a gale. Because the seed is published only after registrations close, attackers cannot precompute which identities will qualify, so each attempt has a fixed low success probability.
